target.title: [AI] fix(memory): use truncateUtf16Safe for dreaming snippet truncation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where dreaming snippet truncation in `memory-core` can produce invalid UTF-16 output. When a complex emoji or surrogate pair straddles the 280-character truncation boundary, `.slice(0, 280)` cuts between the high and low surrogate code units, producing a lone surrogate that can cause display corruption, JSON encoding failures, or database rejections downstream.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace all 5 `.slice(0, N)` calls in `extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-phases.ts` with `truncateUtf16Safe` from `@openclaw/normalization-core/utf16-slice`. `truncateUtf16Safe` checks whether the cut position falls inside a surrogate pair (high surrogate `0xD800–0xDBFF` followed by low surrogate `0xDC00–0xDFFF`) and drops the orphaned high surrogate. The helper is already used in `session-cost-usage`, `cron`, `exec-approval`, and `node-host` for the same purpose. The change is +6/-5 in a single file.

## User Impact

None for typical text content. For memory content that happens to contain an emoji or complex Unicode character at the truncation boundary, the dreaming snippet no longer includes a lone surrogate character, preventing potential downstream encoding issues.

## Evidence

**Environment**: Linux x86_64, Node v24.13.1, OpenClaw 2026.6.11, commit `9ae8803b90`, branch `fix/feishu-format-error-sender-name`.

**Before/after — lone surrogate at 280-char boundary** (both `DAILY_INGESTION_MAX_SNIPPET_CHARS` and `SESSION_INGESTION_MAX_SNIPPET_CHARS` are 280):

```
$ node --import tsx -e "
import { truncateUtf16Safe } from '@openclaw/normalization-core/utf16-slice';
const text = 'A'.repeat(279) + '😀';
// slice(0, 280) cuts between 0xD83D (high) and 0xDE00 (low)
console.log('.slice(0, 280):     last code unit 0x' +
  text.slice(0, 280).charCodeAt(279).toString(16) + ' (LONE HIGH SURROGATE)');
console.log('truncateUtf16Safe:   ' +
  truncateUtf16Safe(text, 280).length + ' code units (clean)');
"
.slice(0, 280):     last code unit 0xD83D (LONE HIGH SURROGATE)
truncateUtf16Safe:   279 code units (clean)
```

**Unit tests:**

```console
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-phases.test.ts --run
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  50 passed (50)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/normalization-core/src/utf16-slice.test.ts --run
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  18 passed (18)
```

**What was NOT tested**: Full dreaming ingestion sweep with real memory files containing emoji at the truncation boundary. The 68 total passing tests cover the dreaming phases and surrogate-safe truncation independently; a full end-to-end dreaming pipeline run with emoji-rich daily/session corpus is deferred.
